0022600037.text: The Atlanta Hawks (7-5, 1st in the Southeast, 5th in the East) visit the Chicago Bulls (1-8, 4th in the Central, 14th in the East) in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group C game, the Hawks' 13th of the season. Atlanta is 4-2 on the road and has lost its last game, while Chicago is on a seven-game losing streak and has won only one of its nine games. The Hawks will be without Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Atlanta lost all three games against Chicago in 2025-26, most recently 126-123 in Atlanta on December 23, 2025.
